Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَلْبِسْنِيْ عَافِيَتَكَ، وَ جَلِّلْنِيْ عَافِيَتَكَ
Translation: And clothe me with Your well-being, and cover me with Your well-being

Arabic text: وَ حَصِّنِّيْ بِعَافِيَتِكَ، وَ أَكْرِمْنِيْ بِعَافِيَتِكَ
Translation: And protect me with Your well-being, and honor me with Your well-being

Arabic text: وَ أَغْنِنِيْ بِعَافِيَتِكَ، وَ تَصَدَّقْ عَلَيَّ بِعَافِيَتِكَ
Translation: And enrich me with Your well-being, and bestow upon me Your well-being

Arabic text: وَ هَبْ لِيْ عَافِيَتَكَ وَ أَفْرِشْنِيْ عَافِيَتَكَ
Translation: And grant me Your well-being, and spread for me Your well-being

Arabic text: وَ أَصْلِحْ لِيْ عَافِيَتَكَ، وَ لَا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنِيْ وَ بَيْنَ عَافِيَتِكَ
Translation: And set right for me Your well-being, and do not separate between me and Your well-being

Arabic text: فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
Translation: In this world and the hereafter

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ عَافِنِيْ عَافِيَةً كَافِيَةً شَافِيَةً عَالِيَةً نَامِيَةً
Translation: And grant me well-being, sufficient, healing, elevated, and growing

Arabic text: عَافِيَةً تُوَلِّدُ فِيْ بَدَنِيْ الْعَافِيَةَ
Translation: Well-being that generates in my body well-being

Arabic text: عَافِيَةَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
Translation: Well-being in this world and the hereafter

Arabic text: وَ امْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِالصِّحَّةِ وَ الْأَمْنِ وَ السَّلَامَةِ فِيْ دِينِيْ وَ بَدَنِي
Translation: And bestow upon me health, security, and safety in my religion and my body

Arabic text: وَ الْبَصِيرَةِ فِيْ قَلْبِيْ، وَ النَّفَاذِ فِيْ أُمُورِيْ، وَ الْخَشْيَةِ لَكَ
Translation: And insight in my heart, and effectiveness in my affairs, and fear of You

Arabic text: وَ الْخَوْفِ مِنْكَ، وَ الْقُوَّةِ عَلَى مَا أَمَرْتَنِيْ بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And dread of You, and strength to fulfill what You have commanded me of Your obedience

Arabic text: وَ الِاجْتِنَابِ لِمَا نَهَيْتَنِيْ عَنْهُ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: And to avoid what You have forbidden me of Your disobedience

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ امْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِالْحَجِّ وَ الْعُمْرَةِ
Translation: O Allah, bestow upon me the Hajj and Umrah

Arabic text: وَ زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ رَسُولِكَ، صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And visitation to the grave of Your Messenger, Your blessings upon him

Arabic text: وَ رَحْمَتُكَ وَ بَرَكَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَى آلِهِ
Translation: And Your mercy and Your blessings upon him and upon his family

Arabic text: وَ آلِ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ أَبَدًا مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي
Translation: And the family of Your Messenger, peace be upon them, forever, as long as You keep me alive

Arabic text: فِيْ عَامِيْ هَذَا وَ فِيْ كُلِّ عَامٍ
Translation: In this year of mine and in every year

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ مَقْبُولًا مَشْكُورًا، مَذْكُورًا لَدَيْكَ
Translation: And make that accepted, appreciated, remembered by You

Arabic text: مَذْخُورًا عِنْدَكَ
Translation: Treasured with You

Arabic text: وَ أَنْطِقْ بِحَمْدِكَ وَ شُكْرِكَ وَ ذِكْرِكَ وَ حُسْنِ الثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْكَ لِسَانِي
Translation: And make my tongue speak with Your praise, Your thanks, Your remembrance, and beautiful commendation of You

Arabic text: وَ اشْرَحْ لِمَرَاشِدِ دِينِكَ قَلْبِي
Translation: And open my heart to the guidance of Your religion

Arabic text: وَ أَعِذْنِيْ وَ ذُرِّيَّتِيْ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
Translation: And protect me and my offspring from the accursed Satan

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَ الْهَامَّةِ و الْعَامَّةِ وَ اللَّامَّةِ
Translation: And from the evil of the poisonous, the vermin, the common evil and the touching evil

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ
Translation: And from the evil of every rebellious devil

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ سُلْطَانٍ عَنِيدٍ
Translation: And from the evil of every obstinate ruler

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مُتْرَفٍ حَفِيدٍ
Translation: And from the evil of every pampered one and his descendants

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ضَعِيفٍ وَ شَدِيدٍ
Translation: And from the evil of every weak and strong one

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَرِيفٍ وَ وَضِيعٍ
Translation: And from the evil of every noble and ignoble one

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ صَغِيرٍ وَ كَبِيرٍ
Translation: And from the evil of every small and great one

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ قَرِيبٍ وَ بَعِيدٍ
Translation: And from the evil of every near and distant one

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لِرَسُولِكَ وَ لِأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ حَرْبًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ
Translation: And from the evil of everyone who has waged war against Your Messenger and his household from among the jinn and humans

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
Translation: And from the evil of every creature that You hold by its forelock

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
Translation: Indeed, You are on a straight path

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ أَرَادَنِيْ بِسُوءٍ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّيْ، وَ ادْحَرْ عَنِّيْ مَكْرَهُ
Translation: And whoever intends evil for me, turn him away from me, and repel his plot from me

Arabic text: وَ ادْرَأْ عَنِّيْ شَرَّهُ، وَ رُدَّ كَيْدَهُ فِيْ نَحْرِهِ
Translation: And avert his evil from me, and return his scheme to his own throat

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ سُدًّا حَتَّى تُعْمِيَ عَنِّيْ بَصَرَهُ
Translation: And place before him a barrier until You blind his sight from me

Arabic text: وَ تُصِمَّ عَنْ ذِكْرِيْ سَمْعَهُ، وَ تُقْفِلَ دُوْنَ إِخْطَارِيْ قَلْبَهُ
Translation: And deafen his hearing from my mention, and lock his heart from thinking of me

Arabic text: وَ تُخْرِسَ عَنِّيْ لِسَانَهُ، وَ تَقْمَعَ رَأْسَهُ
Translation: And silence his tongue from me, and subdue his head

Arabic text: وَ تُذِلَّ عِزَّهُ، وَ تَكْسِرَ جَبَرُوتَهُ
Translation: And humiliate his honor, and break his tyranny

Arabic text: وَ تُذِلَّ رَقَبَتَهُ، وَ تَفْسَخَ كِبْرَهُ
Translation: And humble his neck, and remove his arrogance

Arabic text: وَ تُؤْمِنَنِيْ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ ضَرِّهِ
Translation: And protect me from all his harm

Arabic text: وَ شَرِّهِ وَ غَمْزِهِ وَ هَمْزِهِ وَ لَمْزِهِ وَ حَسَدِهِ
Translation: And his evil, his winking, his whispering, his slander, and his envy

Arabic text: وَ عَدَاوَتِهِ وَ حَبَائِلِهِ وَ مَصَايِدِهِ وَ رَجِلِهِ وَ خَيْلِهِ
Translation: And his enmity, his snares, his traps, his foot-soldiers, and his horsemen

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ عَزِيزٌ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: Indeed, You are Mighty, Powerful
